title: Piano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body - bright red -->
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='#e8352a'/>
  <!-- Top edge highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <!-- Keyboard area - white -->
  <rect x='14' y='52' width='72' height='20' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- Piano keys separators -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <rect x='54' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <rect x='64' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <rect x='74' y='52' width='2' height='12' fill='#d4cfc4'/>
  <!-- Black keys - deep slate blue, lit -->
  <rect x='21' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <rect x='31' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <rect x='41' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <rect x='51' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <rect x='61' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <rect x='71' y='52' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <!-- Smiling face - on the red piano body upper part -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='41' r='4' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='41' r='4' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='39.5' r='1.2' fill='#fff9d6'/>
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='39.5' r='1.2' fill='#fff9d6'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q50 60 68 48' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little legs -->
  <rect x='22' y='80' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#c42a20'/>
  <rect x='68' y='80' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#c42a20'/>
  <!-- Music notes floating -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='20' r='3' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <rect x='22.5' y='8' width='2' height='14' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='16' r='3' fill='#66d9ff'/>
  <rect x='80.5' y='5' width='2' height='13' fill='#66d9ff'/>
</svg>
